card.name: The word triple and its forms
card.fires_on: The word "triple" (or "tripling", "Triple") in medical and general text, such as triple therapy, triple positive, triple screen, or to triple a dose.

modes.label: Triple as a modifier
modes.description: "Triple" placed before a noun or hyphen, naming a combination therapy, test, or antibody status.

modes.label: Triple as a verb or split word
modes.description: "Triple" used as a verb, or the word split into pieces such as "tri" + "ple" or "tri" + "pling".
